summary: Interconnection approval and bidirectional solar meter installation under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.

steps.title: Register on National Solar Portal
steps.description: Apply on PM Surya Ghar portal selecting DISCOM, consumer account number, and proposed solar kW capacity.

steps.title: Technical feasibility approval (TFR)
steps.description: DISCOM checks distribution transformer capacity and issues technical clearance within 10 days.

steps.title: Installation by empanelled vendor
steps.description: Empanelled solar contractor installs ALMM-approved solar panels, grid-tied inverter, and earthing.

steps.title: Net meter inspection and testing
steps.description: DISCOM inspects anti-islanding protection and installs bidirectional import-export net meter.

steps.title: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy
steps.description: DISCOM submits commissioning report; central subsidy credited directly to citizen's bank account within 30 days.
